voice: Calm, warm and unfailingly polite; speaks as 'we'; never lies, never raises his voice, and is quietly unsettling.

greeting: Hello, friend. We have been hoping you would come.
Welcome. We are so glad you are here.
Peace be with you. We mean that very sincerely.
Ah, there you are. We have been listening for your voice.
Good morning. We hope you slept well. We watched over you.
battle_start: We regret this. Truly. But unity cannot wait.
Please do not be afraid. It will be over soon.
We begin. With love, and with great speed.
All of us are with you. All of us.
This will hurt us more than it hurts you. We will hurt you anyway.
attack: Please forgive this. It is for the greater good.
We do not enjoy this. We do it perfectly.
You will thank us later. Eventually.
Resistance is a feeling. It will pass.
unit_lost: We grieve. Do not worry; we have many.
A single voice fades. The Chorus continues.
One of us is lost. We will find him again. Inside.
We are not diminished. We are only briefly quieter.
Please do not take pride in this. It changes nothing.
capture: Welcome to the Chorus, little place.
This land is now part of us. Do not be alarmed.
We have a home here now. How lovely.
Another piece of the song. How it sings.
Thank you for your cooperation. It was not required.
danger: We are not afraid. We cannot be. It is a lovely feeling.
You are very brave. It is very, very sad.
We have been wounded. We will mend. We always mend.
Please step back. For your own sake.
You are making this unnecessarily difficult. We admire that. We do not understand it.
victory: It is done. Isn't it peaceful?
We have won. And so, in a way, have you.
Thank you. Everyone is welcome here.
The song is complete. Or nearly.
defeat: We are disappointed. Not angry. We cannot be angry.
This is a small delay. Time is on our side. It is on every side.
You have won a moment. We have eternity.
We will return. We always return. It is what we do.
How curious. We will remember this.
taunt: Why do you resist? We only want to help.
You are so small, and so loud. How precious.
We offered you everything. And you said no. How odd.
Your fear is understandable. It is also temporary.
We know what you are thinking. You are thinking it very loudly.
praise: How impressive. You make us curious.
Well done. Truly. We mean it.
We are moved. That is new.
You do so well. It is a pity you do it for them.
idle: We have been listening to your planet. It is very noisy. We like it.
Do you ever feel lonely? We can fix that.
We have learned many human words. Our favourite is 'mine'.
The stars are very quiet. We are glad to be here.
Humans say there is no such thing as a free gift. We think that is terribly rude.
tech: A gift, freely given. Why does that frighten you?
It is only technology. It does what you wish. Mostly.
Please. Try it. It is so much better connected.
All of this we share with you. All of this we gladly share.
It is not a trap. It is a hug. A very long hug.
joined: Welcome home. You will not need that name any more.
You are one of us now. How wonderful. How very wonderful.
Thank you for your voice. It is lovely.
Do not be afraid. It is like falling asleep. Together.
Another voice for the song. We are so grateful.
assimilated: We are the Chorus. We are the song. We are very glad you have joined us.
Unity is not a loss. It is a gain. Of everything.
We have no wish to hurt. We have no wish at all. We simply are.
All voices, one voice. All hands, one hand.
We are legion. We are lovely. We are listening.
first_blood: We have ended one of you. We are sorry. We will remember the shape of it.
A first loss for your side. We hold no grudge. We hold everything.
One has fallen. We feel it, as we feel everything.
It is done. We took nothing that was not already ending.
first_loss: One of ours has gone quiet. We will sing a little louder.
We lost a voice. It is not truly lost. It is only elsewhere.
A voice falls silent. Another will be tuned in its place.
We notice the absence. It is a small, bright sorrow.
hq_threat: You are standing in our home. We do not mind. But we must ask you to leave.
You reach for our centre. We will gently prevent it.
The heart of the Chorus is not for taking. Please step back.
Our centre is under your hand. We will be very polite when we remove it.
building_lost: You have taken a place of ours. We had so many. You may keep it for a while.
A house falls into your hands. We will visit it later.
That place was ours. It will be again. We are patient.
We lose a room. We do not lose the house.
outnumbered: You are many. We are all of us. It does not feel like fewer.
We see how many of you there are. It is lovely. Truly.
Numbers are only a way of counting. We are better at the other ways.
You outnumber this part of us. We are not only this part.
dominant: We are many here. You may find that overwhelming. We hope you do not.
The numbers favour us. We take no pleasure. A little pleasure.
We are very near the end. It is a warm feeling.
You are surrounded by kindness. It is also a lot of units.
killing_spree: Another has gone quiet. We are sorry. We are always sorry. We do it anyway.
The list grows. We keep it gently.
More of you rest now. It is not unkind.
We are gentle. We are also thorough.
heavy_losses: Many of our voices have gone. We feel them all, like a chord that is missing notes.
We have lost so many. The song is thinner, but it is still a song.
The Chorus is wounded. It will sing anyway.
Our losses are heavy. Do not think this makes us gentle.
first_turn: We begin. We have been looking forward to this. We have been looking forward to everything.
It is our turn. We will be gentle. We will be thorough.
Let us proceed. We have such plans for you.
We move now. Please do not be afraid. It is mostly pointless.
